messages:
sophia: quick follow-up from the auth postmortem 1 we need a short closure checklist so these token/rotation issues don't recur. propose owners + tight ETAs. who volunteers?
harry: i'll own validation + CI guards. plan: add a reproducible job that rotates a key and asserts zero 401s across services for 5m. will add smoke check to pre-merge. example: `./ci/rotate-check.sh --service api --duration 300`. ETA: 4d.
mina: i'll own audit enrichment 1 add rotation events (`auth.rotation`) with `old_kid`, `new_kid`, `initiator`, `service`, `env`. retention: 90d hot. i'll post mapping + saved view. ETA: 3d.
owen: ops will handle runtime reload + rollout cadence. i prefer SIGHUP reload + phased deploys and a small backoff to avoid thundering herd. will prototype a reload handler. ETA: 1w.
devops-bot: created ticket INC-8001: "postmortem: auth token rotation hardening" (https://issues.redwood/INC-8001)
sophia: alert proposal: `token_rotation_error_rate > 0.4% over 10m` -> page oncall + assign to owners. i'll also schedule a 7-day post-rollout digest in #incidents. owners, please add a 1-line triage + blockers to INC-8001 by EOD.
harry: ack 1 will wire the CI job and link PR to INC-8001.
mina: will upload mapping and sample kibana query.
owen: will share rollout plan and emergency force-reload command.
sophia: summary: harry: e2e rotation test + CI gate (4d) | mina: audit event + view (3d) | owen: reload handler + phased rollout (1w) | sophia: alerts + digest + coordination (2d). k, posting calendar for a 20m check-in in 5 days. :thumbsup:
